configuration_repair.issue: The first manually dispatched run used the repository variable RIIDO_AI_SERVER_TESTNET_BASE_URL=http://ai-api.riido.io and therefore produced a non-staging host artifact.
configuration_repair.action: Updated RIIDO_AI_SERVER_TESTNET_BASE_URL to https://staging.ai-api.riido.io and reran the same workflow inputs.

findings.signal: Staging accepted 98,304 public health/ready requests at concurrency 128 for 120 seconds with 0 failures and p95 latency 152ms.
The testnet load workflow repository variable was corrected from a non-staging HTTP host to https://staging.ai-api.riido.io before accepting the run as staging evidence.
This run measured a warm staging burst against health and readiness endpoints. It did not force an ECS task restart, server cold start, or client-visible post-deployment packet storm.

decision: Bind this artifact as warm staging public burst evidence for boot_burst_capacity, but keep the readiness check partial until a controlled cold-start or force-new-deployment burst run records time-to-ready, accepted requests during startup, and post-event error rate.
